modalities.evidence: clinical profiles, including symptoms and medical history, derived from real-world data in the MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV datasets

output.population: Simulated patient personas grounded in clinical profiles derived from the MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV datasets
output.summary: A patient simulator generating diverse patient personas for multi-turn doctor-patient dialogue, built on clinical profiles drawn from MIMIC-ED and MIMIC-IV, with personas defined along personality, language proficiency, history recall and cognitive confusion axes.
